text:
julia: heads-up: several allocation requests for the us-west-2 tdx-gpu-a100 pool are stuck in the holdlist and failing billing validation. customers are blocked. ticket INC-5732.
kevin: ah — billing tag mismatch again? which tag is failing?
julia: infra-commitment tag expected by our billing pipeline is CostCenter=Infra-Prod but these requests came in with CostCenter=Platform-Prod. the reservation flow rejects them at validation.
maya: can we short-circuit to the dedicated burst pool while we fix tags? severity: P2 — some internal jobs only but a few external trial accounts too.
finance-bot: FYI: if we temporarily move these to the burst pool we will be billed at on-demand rates and it will draw from the shared commit; estimate extra spend ~ $12k/day for 24 GPUs.
samir: we shouldn't just move production traffic. propose: 1) flip tags on the pending nodes 2) replay validations 3) move remaining to burst if flip fails.
kevin: I can flip tags for the 3 pending allocations that are already provisioned. running: `aws ec2 create-tags --resources i-0aa... i-0bb... --tags Key=CostCenter,Value=Infra-Prod`
ops-bot: action logged: ops/alloc-change by kevin at 2024-03-02T18:15:02Z
zara: where did these mis-tagged requests originate? is this a user mistake or a service-side mapping bug?
julia: looks like a billing-mapper regression in the commit-checker service — recent change to mapping rules dropped the Platform-Prod -> Infra-Prod alias. PR #2243.
evan: ok — can we revert PR #2243 in staging and run a small end-to-end test? if it passes, roll to prod canary.
kevin: flip done for i-0aa... and i-0bb..., one still showing pending because it was in provisioning. re-running validation: `./bin/validate-commit --allocation 8d3f2`
samir: results?
kevin: validation passed for the two, allocations released to the pool. the third node failed because provisioning timed out; it's back in holdlist.
maya: I'll open a short-lived burst window for non-prod teams only — tag filter so external customer traffic remains blocked. creates safety.
finance-bot: approved emergency burst for non-prod for next 6 hours. cost center EMERG-BURST.
zara: can we add a guard in commit-checker to accept Platform-Prod until mapping bug is fixed? a soft-accept with audit log.
julia: yes, adding a compatibility shim that logs mismatches and tags audit entries sounds good. I'll make the change and ship a patch to prod canary.
evan: also add a Prometheus alert for HoldlistGrowth rate > 5/min so we notice earlier.
kevin: third node reprovisioned and manual tag applied, validation now passed. releasing allocation.
ops-bot: allocation release recorded: alloc-8d3f2 -> pool tdx-gpu-a100 at 2024-03-02T18:32:10Z
julia: summary: immediate impact mitigated by manual tagging + temporary non-prod burst. root cause: mapping regression (PR #2243) that removed aliasing. next steps: revert-or-shim PR in commit-checker, add holdlist growth alert, and add a small test exercising tag aliases in CI.
samir: I'll own the revert/shim. aiming for a canary in 2 hours.
maya: I'll close INC-5732 once canary completes and we see no new holdlist entries for 30m.
zara: thanks all :+1:
julia: thanks team — leaving this open until canary green. will post final resolution update here.
